title: Windmill Heights
description: Climb from farmland through stronger wind, ride the windmill lifts, enter its machinery and emerge onto the exposed ridge.

signs.text:
The lower farmland
Jump the farm walls beneath the sails

The windy hillside
Climb against the growing wind

The windmill exterior
Ride the counterweight up to the mill

Within the mill machinery
Drop through the mill’s service rooms

The ridge beyond the sails
Brake before the last exposed ledges

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery
